mapper.select: SELECT t.space_id,t.creator_id AS user_id,t.conversation_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.execution_slot z WHERE z.task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.attempt a WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND a.status='RUNNING') AS live,t.cancel_requested AS stop_requested,coalesce(clock_timestamp()-c.requested_at>interval '5 seconds',false) AS overdue FROM pf.task t LEFT JOIN pf.task_cancellation c ON c.task_id=t.id WHERE t.id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER}

SELECT m.id,m.space_id,m.task_id,m.attempt_id,t.creator_id AS user_id,t.conversation_id,a.owner_id,a.fencing_token AS fence,m.status,r.state AS reservation_state,r.amount_micros AS allowance,m.reconciliation_revision AS revision,m.price_version,m.provider_request_id,m.provider_kind,s.config_json::text AS config_json,m.input_tokens,m.output_tokens,m.cost_micros FROM pf.model_call m JOIN pf.task t ON t.id=m.task_id JOIN pf.attempt a ON a.id=m.attempt_id JOIN pf.budget_reservation r ON r.call_id=m.id JOIN pf.chat_config_snapshot s ON s.id=t.config_snapshot_id WHERE m.id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}

SELECT m.id,m.space_id,m.task_id,m.attempt_id,t.creator_id AS user_id,t.conversation_id,a.owner_id,a.fencing_token AS fence,m.status,r.state AS reservation_state,r.amount_micros AS allowance,m.reconciliation_revision AS revision,m.price_version,m.provider_request_id,m.provider_kind,s.config_json::text AS config_json,m.input_tokens,m.output_tokens,m.cost_micros FROM pf.model_call m JOIN pf.task t ON t.id=m.task_id JOIN pf.attempt a ON a.id=m.attempt_id JOIN pf.budget_reservation r ON r.call_id=m.id JOIN pf.chat_config_snapshot s ON s.id=t.config_snapshot_id WHERE m.id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} FOR UPDATE OF m,r

SELECT m.id,m.space_id,m.task_id,m.attempt_id,t.creator_id AS user_id,t.conversation_id,a.owner_id,a.fencing_token AS fence,m.status,r.state AS reservation_state,r.amount_micros AS allowance,m.reconciliation_revision AS revision,m.price_version,m.provider_request_id,m.provider_kind,s.config_json::text AS config_json,m.input_tokens,m.output_tokens,m.cost_micros FROM pf.model_call m JOIN pf.task t ON t.id=m.task_id JOIN pf.attempt a ON a.id=m.attempt_id JOIN pf.budget_reservation r ON r.call_id=m.id JOIN pf.chat_config_snapshot s ON s.id=t.config_snapshot_id WHERE m.task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND m.space_id=#{space,jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY m.ordinal
SELECT request_hash FROM pf.model_call_reconciliation WHERE command_id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}

SELECT count(*) FROM pf.execution_stop_receipt WHERE attempt_id=#{lease.attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_id=#{lease.taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND space_id=#{lease.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND owner_id=#{lease.ownerId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND fencing_token=#{lease.fence}
SELECT count(*) FROM pf.model_call m JOIN pf.budget_reservation r ON r.call_id=m.id WHERE m.task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND (m.status IN ('STARTED','UNKNOWN') OR r.state='RECONCILING')

SELECT count(*) FROM pf.execution_stop_receipt s JOIN pf.attempt a ON a.id=s.attempt_id AND a.space_id=s.space_id AND a.task_id=s.task_id AND a.owner_id=s.owner_id AND a.fencing_token=s.fencing_token WHERE s.task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND a.fencing_token=(SELECT max(fencing_token) FROM pf.attempt WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER})
SELECT count(*) FROM pf.attempt WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.task_cancellation(task_id,space_id,command_id,actor_id,attempt_id,owner_id,generation,fencing_token) SELECT t.id,t.space_id,#{command,jdbcType=OTHER},#{actor.userId,jdbcType=OTHER},a.id,a.owner_id,a.dispatch_generation,a.fencing_token FROM pf.task t LEFT JOIN pf.attempt a ON a.task_id=t.id AND a.status='RUNNING' WHERE t.id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND t.space_id=#{actor.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO pf.execution_stop_receipt(attempt_id,space_id,task_id,owner_id,fencing_token,source,evidence_hash) VALUES(#{lease.attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.taskId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.ownerId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.fence},'LOCAL_QUIESCENCE',#{hash}) ON CONFLICT(attempt_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO pf.execution_stop_receipt(attempt_id,space_id,task_id,owner_id,fencing_token,source,evidence_hash) VALUES(#{proof.attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{space,jdbcType=OTHER},#{proof.taskId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{proof.ownerId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{proof.fence},'HOST_STOP_PROOF',#{proof.evidenceHash}) ON CONFLICT(attempt_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.model_call SET provider_kind=#{kind} WHERE id=#{call,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='STARTED'
UPDATE pf.task SET reason_code='EXECUTION_STOP_UNCONFIRMED',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND reason_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'EXECUTION_STOP_UNCONFIRMED'
UPDATE pf.model_call SET reconciliation_revision=reconciliation_revision+1 WHERE id=#{call,jdbcType=OTHER} AND reconciliation_revision=#{expected}

WITH released AS (UPDATE pf.budget_reservation SET state='RELEASED' WHERE call_id=#{call,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state IN ('RESERVED','RECONCILING') RETURNING tokens,amount_micros) UPDATE pf.budget_account SET reserved_tokens=reserved_tokens-(SELECT coalesce(sum(tokens),0) FROM released),reserved_micros=reserved_micros-(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_micros),0) FROM released),version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{space,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{user,jdbcType=OTHER}
UPDATE pf.budget_reservation SET state='SETTLED' WHERE call_id=#{call,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state IN ('RESERVED','RECONCILING')

UPDATE pf.budget_account SET reserved_tokens=reserved_tokens-9216,reserved_micros=reserved_micros-#{allowance},consumed_tokens=consumed_tokens+#{tokens},consumed_micros=consumed_micros+#{cost},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{space,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{user,jdbcType=OTHER}
